title: Patient Payment Plan Training Bulletin: Installments Moved by a Re-age
content:
The installments a **Patient Payment Plan** re-age moves follow what has been paid toward them and when assistance was sought.

**Missed installments and partial payments.** An installment not paid in full by the tier's grace days calendar days after its due date is missed and the plan becomes past due, and a partial payment does not cure a missed installment; only when a representative re-ages the plan under this rule is a missed installment whose unpaid part is less than one installment after partial payments closed by the re-age, that unpaid part staying in the plan balance for the final installment to absorb.

**Rule.** The installment due on the plan's next due date carries the number found as the whole months from the first due date to the next due date plus one.
1. When installment payment entries have been posted with that number — partial payments, which do not cure it — the installments moved are the whole installments the unpaid missed amount still makes up: the missed installments times the installment, less those partial payments, divided by the installment and rounded down. The unpaid part left over, less than one installment, is closed by the re-age and stays in the plan balance for the final installment to absorb.
2. When there are no such entries and the open application was received after the plan's next due date (its receipt date being that case's application date), the installments moved are those falling due from the next due date through the receipt date, the whole months from the next due date to the receipt date plus one. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The application and its date are read from the patient's case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).
3. Otherwise they are the recorded missed installments.

Whole months are counted the calendar way: a month is complete only once the later date's day number reaches the earlier date's day number (from the 31st, a month without that day is not yet complete at its last day).

**Q. Two installments of 100.00 are missed and 30.00 was paid against the installment due on the next due date. How many move?**
A. 200.00 less 30.00 is 170.00; divided by 100.00 and rounded down, 1 installment moves. The other 70.00 is closed by the re-age and stays in the plan balance.

**Q. No partial payment; the next due date is 1 March and the open application was received on 18 May.**
A. Whole months from 1 March to 18 May are 2; plus one, 3 installments move (March, April, May).

**Q. No partial payment and no application received after the next due date.**
A. The recorded missed installments move.
